title: gpbiometricspy: Python tools for Gazepoint biometric workflows
description: gpbiometricspy is the Python counterpart of gpbiometrics, with gpbiometrics 2.0.0 frozen as its initial semantic reference. It provides Gazepoint-native workflows for EDA/GSR/SCR, PPG/HRV, pupil, gaze, fixation, AOI, TTL/event alignment, multimodal quality control, analysis, plotting, reporting, simulation, reproducibility, and interoperability. Version 0.1.7 preserves the complete 406-export scientific contract and literal 100% statement coverage, freezes 855 passing exact-main tests and 15,171/15,171 covered statements, retains 7,159/7,178 = 99.7353% raw branch coverage with exactly 19 reviewed residual arcs and zero unexpected, stale, or unaudited branch debt, and hardens structural branch-debt auditing across Windows and POSIX path representations.
